finding.message: This async callback's work is never awaited. This callback returns before its work finishes and hands back nothing to wait on. The caller carries on too early, and a later failure is raised where nobody catches it.

presentation.description: This callback returns before its work finishes and hands back nothing to wait on. The caller carries on too early, and a later failure is raised where nobody catches it.

derivedFacts: the callback waits on asynchronous work
the slot it is handed to ignores what it returns
a failure after the first wait is not delivered to any caller
reachableWhen: whenever the module's top-level code runs

presentation.more: This callback awaits, so it returns to its caller at the first wait and finishes later — but its result is nothing, so the work in flight has no handle anyone can hold. The caller carries on as though the work were done, several such calls run at once rather than in turn, and a failure after the first wait has nowhere to go: it is raised where nobody catches it, which on some runtimes ends the process. Return the work's handle and have the caller wait for it, or hand the callback to something that waits for what it returns.
